news.title: Racism Scandal Rocks FIFA U15 World Cup! England Players Storm Off Pitch After Alleged Racial Abuse During
news.lede: England's Under-15 football team walked off the pitch during their FIFA U15 World Cup and Festival match against the Republic of Ireland after one of their players allegedly suffered racial abuse. The Group C encounter, played in Baku, Azerbaijan, on Monday, October 26, was abandoned with Ireland leading 4-1 following the incident in the closing stages of the match. FIFA has confirmed that it is investigating the matter.The incident reportedly occurred in the final minute of the contest after an altercation between players from both sides. Following the exchange, an England player approached the team bench and informed the coaching staff about an alleged racist remark made by an Irish opponent.

news.title: New Zealand wrap up group fixtures at FIFA U-15 Boys World Cup
news.lede: New Zealand have finished their five group fixtures at the FIFA U-15 Boys’ World Cup and Festival in Baku, Azerbaijan. They lost 4-2 to Puerto Rico, then were edged 1-0 by Mozambique. Main photo: New Zealand’s squad at the FIFA U-15 Boys’ World Cup. Photo credit: Aziz Karimov – FIFA/FIFA via Getty Images.

news.title: 'Success is a motivation, not the end goal' - World Cup winner Luis de la Fuente reacts to Ballon d'Or coach award
news.lede: Luis de la Fuente has cemented his legacy as one of the modern greats after being named the best coach in world football. The Spanish tactician accepted the prestigious award following a historic campaign that saw his national team reach the summit of the sport.A night of glory for the Spanish mastermindDe la Fuente has officially been crowned the world's best coach after receiving the Johan Cruyff Trophy at the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony . The veteran manager was the clear favourite for the accolade following Spain's dominant run to the World Cup title, where his side captivated fans with a blend of tactical discipline and creative flair.Standing on the stage to accept the trophy, De la Fuente remained humble despite the magnitude of the occasion. He was quick to acknowledge the quality of his peers and the collective effort required to reach such heights.

news.title: Luis de la Fuente wins Men's Coach of the Year after Spain's World Cup triumph
news.lede: Spain coach Luis de la Fuente has been named Men's Coach of the Year at the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony in London, following an extraordinary year in which he guided his country to World Cup glory.The 65 year old received the prestigious honour after leading Spain to their second FIFA World Cup title, defeating defending champions Argentina 1-0 in a dramatic final on July 19. Ferran Torres scored the winner in the 106th minute as Spain lifted the trophy for the first time since 2010. Accepting the award, De la Fuente was quick to share the credit with his players and coaching staff." Good evening, it is a real honour for me to receive this prize," he said."

news.title: Samoa U17 women exit Morroco World Cup with valuable lessons
news.lede: Samoa exited the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup at the group stage on Monday after defeats to the USA, China PR and Kenya.In an interview with the Samoa Observer, Head coach Juan Chang Urrea said the competition was immense and elite, and that the team faced some of the best sides in the world.“.
